create_audio_feature: create an Audio feature connector with file format, shape, dtype, and sample rate metadata
encode_audio_example: encode an audio numpy array or file path into a TensorFlow example for dataset storage
decode_audio_example: decode a TensorFlow example back into an audio tensor using the configured decoder
build_lazy_audio_decoder: build a lazy audio decoder that stores raw bytes and decodes FLAC or pydub-supported formats on load
save_audio_to_wav: save a numpy audio array as a PCM WAV bytestring with configurable sample rate and bit depth
